hits.title: Pressure Vessels with Reinforced Heads
hits.snippet: The invention relates to a pressure vessel (1) with a reinforced head (22) and a method of manufacturing said pressure vessel (1), said pressure vessel comprising an inner vessel (2) formed by a cylindrical middle portion (21) , two arched heads (22) respectively closing the middle part (21) on …
full_claims: 1. A pressure vessel comprising an inner vessel formed by a cylindrical middle part, two arched vessel heads which respectively close the middle part on both sides, and an outer layer wound around the inner vessel for reinforcing the inner vessel against pressure loads, wherein the outer layer comprises at least one vessel head reinforcing layer made of a fiber composite material and a pressure vessel reinforcing layer, wherein the vessel head reinforcing layer at least partially covers the vessel head, the pressure vessel reinforcing layer covers the vessel head and the middle part, and a contour-stable preform serving as the vessel head reinforcing layer is provided on at least one of the vessel heads; the prefabricated member with the stable contour is formed by weaving fiber materials, the weaving angle of the fiber materials on the edge of the end socket of the prefabricated member is 160 degrees, one or more reinforcing ribs are woven into the woven prefabricated member, and the direction of the reinforcing ribs is basically parallel to the cylinder axis in the middle of the cylinder.
2. The pressure vessel of claim 1, wherein the dimensionally stable preform is made of a fibrous material stitched to a clothable carrier material.

3. A pressure vessel according to claim 2, wherein one or more reinforcing bars are sewn together on the carrier material, the direction of the reinforcing bars being substantially parallel to the axis of the cylindrical central portion.
4. A pressure vessel according to claim 2 or 3, wherein the carrier material is secured directly to the closure by an adhesive layer.

5. The pressure vessel of claim 1, wherein the preform is pushed into at least a portion of the pressure vessel reinforcement layer that is wound around the cap or is a wet fiber composite and is secured in the cap area by the matrix material of the pressure vessel reinforcement layer.
6. The pressure vessel of claim 1, wherein the pressure vessel reinforcement layer covers the closure reinforcement layer and the preform is secured to the closure head for profile stability.

7. Pressure vessel according to claim 1, characterized in that the preform is a hardened preform for arranging on the closure head, wherein the inner contour of the preform cooperates with the closure head, the outer contour of the preform being designed such that the pressure vessel reinforcement layer can be placed thereon, wherein the outer contour in the edge region of the closure head exhibits an extension of the middle portion of the inner vessel, wherein the further pressure vessel reinforcement layer further comprises a radially wound inner layer which, as a continuous layer, is wound on the middle portion and is wound directly on the outer contour in the edge region for further winding of the entire preform thereon by means of the outer layer of one or more pressure vessel reinforcement layers.

8. A method for manufacturing a pressure vessel according to claim 1, comprising an inner vessel formed by a cylindrical middle part, two arched closures closing the middle part on both sides, respectively, and an outer layer wound around the closures and the inner vessel for reinforcing the inner vessel against pressure loads, wherein the outer layer comprises at least one closure reinforcement layer and a pressure vessel reinforcement layer made of a fibre composite material; the method comprises the following steps: -a manufacturing step of manufacturing a contour-stable preform by means of weaving techniques or by means of sewing a fibrous material onto a clothable carrier material, the preform being used as the cap reinforcement layer of at least one of the caps; -a step of arranging the head reinforcing layer on the head so that the head reinforcing layer at least partially covers the head; and a setting step, namely setting the pressure vessel reinforcing layer on the seal head and the middle part, wherein the pressure vessel reinforcing layer is arranged on the seal head reinforcing layer from the outside.

9. The method of claim 8, wherein the step of fabricating the dimensionally stable preform comprises braiding the dimensionally stable preform from a fiber material, and wherein the preform has a braiding angle of at least 140 ° at the closure head edge.

10. The method of claim 9, wherein the weaving further comprises the step of additionally weaving one or more reinforcing ribs in a direction substantially parallel to the cylindrical axis of the cylindrical midsection.
11. The method of claim 8, wherein the step of fabricating the contour-stabilized preform by means of stitching comprises helically stitching the fibrous material to the carrier material.

12. Method according to any one of claims 8-11, comprising the additional step of at least spot welding a preform made of a thermoplastic matrix with the closure head in order to fix the preform to the closure head.

13. The method according to any of claims 8-11, comprising the additional step of: -a hardening step of a preform having an inner contour that cooperates with the closure and an outer contour on which the pressure vessel reinforcement layer can be placed, wherein the outer contour in the edge region of the closure exhibits an extension of the middle of the inner vessel; -a winding step, in which an inner layer is wound as a radial winding of the pressure vessel reinforcement layer on the middle part and directly on the outer contour of the edge region; a subsequent winding step, wherein one or more outer layers of the pressure vessel reinforcing layer are wound around the entire preform.
hits.full_abstract: 本发明涉及一种具有加强的封头(22)的压力容器(1)和制造所述压力容器(1)的方法，所述压力容器包括由筒状中部(21)形成的内容器(2)、两个分别在两侧封闭所述中部(21)的拱形封头(22)和缠绕在所述内容器(2)上的外层(3)，所述外层用于加强所述内容器(2)以抵抗压力负荷，其中，所述外层(3)包括由纤维复合材料(FVM)制成的至少一个封头加强层(31)和压力容器加强层(32)，其中，所述封头加强层(31)至少部分覆盖所述封头(22)，所述压力容器加强层(32)覆盖所述封头(22)和中部(21)，并且用做所述封头加强层(31)的轮廓稳定的预制件(5)被设置在至少一个所述封头(22)上，优选地，在两个所述封头(22)上。 The invention relates to a pressure vessel (1) with a reinforced head (22) and a method of manufacturing said pressure vessel (1), said pressure vessel comprising an inner vessel (2) formed by a cylindrical middle portion (21) , two arched heads (22) respectively closing the middle part (21) on both sides and an outer layer (3) wound on the inner container (2), the outer layer is used to strengthen the content A device (2) to resist pressure loads, wherein the outer layer (3) comprises at least one head reinforcement layer (31) and a pressure vessel reinforcement layer (32) made of fiber composite material (FVM), wherein the The head reinforcement layer (31) at least partially covers the head (22), the pressure vessel reinforcement layer (32) covers the head (22) and the middle part (21), and serves as the head reinforcement The contoured preform (5) of the layer (31) is arranged on at least one of said heads (22), preferably on both of said heads (22).

full_claims: 1. The utility model provides a fiber reinforcement resin matrix combined material barrel connection structure, includes combined material barrel (1), its characterized in that: the composite material barrel is characterized by further comprising a metal connector (2) and fibers (3) wound in the circumferential direction, first connecting parts with outer ends shrinking inwards are formed at two end parts of the composite material barrel (1), the metal connector (2) comprises a pipe column and a second connecting part which are combined with each other and are in a dovetail shape, a baffle ring is arranged at the joint of the pipe column and the second connecting part, a groove-shaped fiber winding area (5) is formed between the baffle ring and the second connecting part, the outer side surface of the second connecting part and the side surface of the baffle ring opposite to the second connecting part are respectively provided with ring grooves (4) distributed at intervals, the first connecting part of the composite material cylinder body (1) is sleeved outside the second connecting part of the metal connector (2) in a matching way, the fiber winding device is characterized in that the fiber winding area (5) is filled with the circumferential winding fibers (3), and the composite material cylinder body (1), the metal connector (2) and the circumferential winding fibers (3) are of an integrally formed structure.

2. The fiber reinforced resin based composite material cylinder connection structure according to claim 1, wherein: the composite material cylinder (1), the metal connector (2) and the circumferential winding fibers (3) are integrally formed by a mould pressing method, a hot pressing tank method, a resin transfer molding method or a vacuum bag method.

3. The fiber reinforced resin based composite material cylinder connection structure according to claim 1, wherein: the matrix of the composite material cylinder (1) and/or the circumferential winding fiber (3) is cyanate ester resin, phenolic resin, epoxy resin, bismaleimide resin, benzoxazine resin or polyimide resin, and the reinforcement is carbon fiber, glass fiber, Kevlar fiber, quartz fiber, basalt fiber, ceramic fiber, boron fiber or plant fiber.

4. The fiber reinforced resin based composite material cylinder connection structure according to claim 1, wherein: the composite material barrel (1) adopts 0 degree, 45 degree and 90 degree layering, the layering proportion of 0 degree is 40-50%, the layering proportion of 45 degree is 40-50%, the layering proportion of 90 degree is 10-20%, the fiber 0 degree is along the axial direction of the composite material barrel (1), the fiber 90 degree is along the circumferential direction of the composite material barrel (1), and the thickness direction of the layering is along the radial direction of the composite material barrel (1).

5. The fiber reinforced resin based composite material cylinder connection structure according to claim 1, wherein: the section of the main structure in the middle of the composite material cylinder body (1) is circular, oval, trapezoidal, square, rectangular or triangular, the main structure of the composite material cylinder body (1) is of a uniform section or a variable section along the axial direction, and the metal connector (2) is made of titanium alloy, stainless steel, aluminum alloy, aluminum lithium alloy or magnesium alloy.

6. The fiber reinforced resin based composite material cylinder connection structure according to claim 1, wherein: the winding mode of the circumferential winding fiber (3) is that after a plurality of layers of the composite material cylinder (1) are continuously laid, the circumferential winding fiber (3) is continuously wound for a plurality of circles, and the composite material cylinder (1) and the circumferential winding fiber (3) are repeatedly laid in such a way until the fiber winding area (5) is filled; or after the composite material cylinder (1) is completely paved, the circumferential winding fibers (3) start to wind to the fiber winding area (5) which is filled.

7. The fiber reinforced resin based composite material cylinder connection structure according to claim 1, wherein: the included angle of the fiber winding area (5) is 45-80 degrees, the included angle is arc transition and the arc radius is not less than 1mm, and the outer end of the second connecting portion is of an arc structure and the arc radius is not less than 0.1 mm.

8. The fiber reinforced resin based composite material cylinder connection structure according to claim 1, wherein: the axial cross-section of annular (4) is triangle-shaped, trapezoidal, rectangle or fan-shaped, contained angle less than or equal to 90 between the lateral surface that annular (4) on the second connecting portion deviate from the side of keeping off the ring and the second connecting portion, the contained angle less than or equal to 90 between the side that deviates from the tubular column of annular (4) on the fender ring and the side of keeping off the ring.

9. The fiber reinforced resin based composite material cylinder connection structure according to claim 1, wherein: when the composite material cylinder body (1) and the metal connector (2) are integrally formed, a glass fiber fabric layer is laid on the outer side surface of the second connecting part of the metal connector (2) firstly.

10. The fiber reinforced resin based composite material cylinder connection structure according to claim 1, wherein: the composite material barrel is characterized in that reinforcing ribs and/or reinforcing ribs are assembled inside the composite material barrel (1), and the reinforcing ribs and/or the reinforcing ribs are assembled with the composite material barrel (1) into a whole by adopting a glue joint structure or a co-curing structure.
hits.full_abstract: The invention relates to a fiber reinforced resin matrix composite material cylinder connecting structure, which comprises a composite material cylinder, a metal connector and circumferentially wound fibers, wherein first connecting parts with the outer ends shrinking inwards are formed at two end parts of the composite material cylinder, the metal connector comprises a pipe column and a dovetail-shaped second connecting part which are mutually combined, a baffle ring is arranged at the combining position of the pipe column and the second connecting part, a fiber winding area is formed between the baffle ring and the second connecting part, annular grooves distributed at intervals are respectively formed on the outer side surface of the second connecting part and the side surface of the baffle ring opposite to the second connecting part, the first connecting part of the composite material cylinder is sleeved on the outer side of the second connecting part of the metal connector in a matched manner, the circumferentially wound fibers are filled in the fiber winding area, and the composite material cylinder, the metal connector and the circumferentially wound fibers are of an integrally. The invention can enhance the connection strength of the composite material cylinder and the metal structure, simplify the assembly process, improve the connection efficiency and shorten the production period.
